title: Parent Trait Bounds
goal: Satisfy a supertrait requirement by implementing both the base trait and sub-trait.
hints: Audit requires Loggable as a supertrait, so Event must implement Loggable explicitly.
Trait methods require method call parentheses.
explanation: Because `Audit` has supertrait `Loggable`, any struct implementing `Audit` must also implement `Loggable`. Omitting `impl Loggable for Event` causes `E0277`. Omitting the `log_message` body inside `impl Loggable` causes `E0046`. Calling `item.log_message()` invokes the supertrait method. Omitting parentheses causes `E0615`, and calling `log()` causes `E0599` because no such method exists.
